library.description: Runtime-neutral lifecycle primitives: scopes, generations, quiescence tracking and dispose transactions.

blocks.text: English
异步代码最难写对的是“收尾”：谁先关、谁后关；关到一半出错怎么办；旧请求晚到了怎么办；还有请求没处理完，要不要等、等多久。`@migaia/lifecycle` 把这些收尾规则做成一组可以组合的小工具，让关闭、取消和替换在并发情况下依然正确。它不依赖 DOM 或 Node，浏览器、Node、Bun、Deno 和 Worker 里都能用。

items: 发布新版本时，进行中的请求被砍断：容器收到 SIGTERM 后立即退出，正在写数据库的请求返回 502，写了一半的数据丢失。根因是关闭流程没有“先停止接收、再等进行中的工作、最后关连接”这几步。
搜索框显示的是旧结果：用户输入 “a” 又输入 “ab”，“a” 的慢响应比 “ab” 晚到，把新结果覆盖了。根因是没有判断“这个结果还是不是最新的那次请求”。
切换页面后消息重复、内存上涨：离开页面时漏掉了一个订阅或计时器，回到页面后同一条消息被处理两次。根因是清理函数散落在各处，靠人记。
初始化到一半失败，留下半个对象：连上数据库、打开缓存后，第三步失败了，前两个资源没人关。
清理代码自己抛错：`finally` 里关闭数据库失败，后面的缓存再也没有关闭，最初的错误也被盖掉了。

blocks.text: 下面是一个 Node HTTP 服务的优雅停机。请求处理到一半时开始关闭：服务先停止接收新请求，等进行中的请求完成（最多 5 秒），再关闭数据库连接池。用 Node 24 直接运行。
输出：

blocks.code:
1. 停止接收新请求，等待进行中的请求
2. 进行中的请求都已完成
3. 关闭数据库连接池
客户端收到: 订单已保存

blocks.text: `boundedWait` 的截止时间是 `performance.now()` 时间轴上的绝对时刻，不是 `Date.now()`。

blocks.text: 很多服务的停机代码是这样的：
改用作用域后，释放顺序由登记顺序决定，一项失败不影响其余资源，等待有明确的截止时间。新加一个资源时只需要在创建它的地方 `own()` 一次，不用回到停机代码里补一行。

items: 即使某项清理抛错，其余资源也会照常释放。 失败的原始错误会被加上 `code` 后交给你（多个失败合并成 `AggregateError`），不会被后面的错误盖掉。也可以选择收集成数组（`collect`）或交给日志函数（`report`）。
即使 `dispose()` 被同时调用多次，也只执行一轮释放。 所有调用拿到同一个 Promise，不会重复关闭同一个连接。
释放顺序默认与登记顺序相反。 先登记的连接池最后关，后登记的、依赖它的服务先关，依赖关系天然正确；需要时也可以按优先级排序，或先尝试优雅关闭、超时再强制关闭。
旧请求即使晚到，也不会覆盖新结果。 新请求开始时，旧请求会收到取消信号；旧请求已经拿到的资源可以交给释放函数回收。
等待一定有上限。 `boundedWait` 在截止时间返回，不会因为一个卡住的任务挂住整个关闭流程；它也不会擅自取消那个任务。
初始化失败时自动回收，成功后整体移交。 半路失败的资源按相反顺序释放；全部成功后一次性交给长期作用域。
可以和原生 `using` 一起用。 异步作用域支持 `await using`，同步作用域支持 `using`；相比手写 `try/finally`，多了并发安全的释放、错误策略和截止时间。

blocks.text: README 演示了请求按时完成的情况。这里演示另一种情况：有一个请求要 10 秒才能完成，超过了 300 毫秒的停机期限。`boundedWait` 到期后返回 `false`，停机流程继续往下走，不会被这个请求挂住；它也不会取消那个请求。
输出：

blocks.code:
还有 1 个请求没完成，继续关闭
关闭数据库连接池

blocks.text: 在真实服务里，把 `app.dispose()` 接到 `process.once('SIGTERM', …)` 上，并把截止时间设得比平台的强制结束时间短一些。例如 Kubernetes 默认在 SIGTERM 之后 30 秒强制结束容器，截止时间可以设成 25 秒。

sections.id: 只采用最新一次请求的结果
sections.heading: 只采用最新一次请求的结果

blocks.text: 每次请求前调用 `begin()`，拿到这次请求的 `token` 和 `signal`。新的 `begin()` 会让上一次请求“过期”，并取消它的 `signal`。拿到结果后，先用 `isCurrent(token)` 确认它仍是最新的那次，再更新页面。
输出：

blocks.code: 页面显示: [ 'ab 的结果' ]

blocks.text: `begin({ timeoutMs })` 可以给一次请求设置超时，到期时取消它的 `signal`。如果旧请求已经拿到了需要释放的资源（例如一个连接），用 `adopt(token, value, release)`：结果仍是最新的就返回 `true` 交给你，否则调用 `release(value)` 回收它并返回 `false`。
页面打开时创建一个作用域，把每个订阅、计时器、连接都登记进去；离开页面时只调用一次 `dispose()`。释放顺序与登记顺序相反，所以先登记连接、后登记依赖连接的订阅，离开时就会先退订、再断开连接。
输出：

blocks.code:
收到消息
清除心跳计时器
取消订阅消息
断开连接

blocks.text: `dispose()` 之后再调用 `own()` 会抛出 `SCOPE_TERMINAL`，避免在已经离开的页面上再挂资源。全部清理都是同步的（例如 DOM 监听器）时，可以用 `createSyncLifecycleScope()`，它的 `dispose()` 立即完成，还支持 `using` 语法。

sections.id: 初始化失败时回收已经创建的资源
sections.heading: 初始化失败时回收已经创建的资源

blocks.text: 初始化分好几步时，把每一步创建的资源先登记到临时作用域里。全部成功后调用 `commitTo(app)`，把它们整体交给长期作用域；中途失败就调用 `rollback()`，按相反顺序回收已经创建的资源。
输出：

blocks.code:
回收：关闭缓存
  回收：断开数据库
安装失败: 路由冲突
插件已安装
应用关闭：
  回收：关闭缓存
  回收：断开数据库

blocks.text: `commitTo()` 和 `rollback()` 只能二选一、只能选一次。如果目标作用域在移交途中已经开始关闭，已经移交的部分留在目标里，没移交的部分由临时作用域回收，然后抛出 `PROVISIONAL_PARENT_CLOSED`，原始错误在 `cause` 上。
两次保存几乎同时发出时，慢的旧请求可能最后到达服务器，把新内容覆盖掉。`createMutationQueue()` 让修改一个接一个执行：后一次保存要等前一次完成才开始。
输出：

blocks.code:
不排队时服务器保存的是: 草稿 v1
排队后服务器保存的是: 草稿 v2

blocks.text: 队列不会并发执行任务。如果一个任务在执行时又往同一个队列提交任务并等待它，就会永远等不到；给任务传 `{ owner }` 后，这种情况会立即以 `QUEUE_SELF_DEPENDENCY` 失败，而不是卡住。

blocks.text: 默认错误策略是 `throw`：所有资源都会尝试释放，结束后再把失败抛出。只有一个失败时，抛出的就是原始错误本身，只是多了 `source` 和 `code` 属性；多个失败时抛出 `AggregateError`，每个原始错误都在 `errors` 里。
输出：

blocks.code:
清除计时器
关闭 socket
dispose() 失败: 缓存文件被占用 (SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED)
作用域状态: terminal

blocks.text: 不想让关闭流程抛错时，用 `createLifecycleScope({ errorPolicy: 'collect' })`，`dispose()` 会把失败作为数组返回；或者用 `{ errorPolicy: 'report', report }`，把每个失败交给日志函数。

blocks.text: 这些类型从根入口导出，不创建runtime state：

items: `IDisposer`：调用方持有的同步、应幂等释放函数形状。
`ILifecycleOwner`：只表达可接收显式 `IReleaseDescriptor` 的 ownership handoff；`ProvisionalScope.commitTo()` 依赖它，因此同步/异步 scope 都能作为 parent，而无需共享各自不同的 dispose 形状。
`ILifecycleState`：资源容器存活轴；领域加载状态由各自 owner 定义。
`ICollectedError`：失败加调用方提供的 source 标签。当前声明的两个字段均 readonly；这是编译期约束，collector 不冻结每个 item。未分类原生错误原位附码，primitive 包装，已有合法外部身份保持不变；raw ledger 不经过该策略投影。
`IErrorPolicy`：四种释放错误投影。新调用方通常选 `throw`、`collect` 或 `report`；`firstError` 主要服务已有 first-error-wins 迁移。
`IReleaseContext`、`IReleaseDescriptor` 在下一节完整说明；其他命名类型紧邻其构造函数章节。

blocks.text: 两条正交轴：容器存活轴（`open → closing → terminal`，由 `close()`/`dispose()` 驱动）与资源释放本身。`close()` 永远同步、幂等、不调用用户代码；`dispose()` 永远异步。

sections.id: ireleasedescriptor-领域表达释放意图的唯一词汇
sections.heading: IReleaseDescriptor —— 领域表达释放意图的唯一词汇

blocks.code:
type IReleaseDescriptor = {
  readonly syncSafe?: boolean
  readonly order?: number
  readonly graceful?: (context: IReleaseContext) => void | PromiseLike<void>
  readonly gracefulTimeoutMs?: number
  readonly force: (context: IReleaseContext) => void | PromiseLike<void>
  readonly gcFallback?: boolean
  readonly custom?: (context: IReleaseContext) => void | PromiseLike<void>
}

blocks.text: 字段语义：

items: `syncSafe?: boolean` —— 声明该 descriptor 可被 `SyncLifecycleScope` 接受，不改变 `LifecycleScope` 本身的静态类型（同/异步由构造的具体类型决定，不由 descriptor 推断）。
`order?: number` —— 释放排序键，缺省按 `0`；只在 `DisposeTransaction` 的 `order` 模式下生效，数值大者先释放（往「释放顺序的下方」沉降，与分配顺序相反）。
`graceful?` —— 优雅释放；超时只放弃等待（不取消它），随即降级到 `force`；`graceful` 本身抛错（非超时）不会阻止 `force` 继续跑。同步返回的 `graceful` 视为已完成释放：即使超过预算也不再跑 `force`，只通过 `context.report` 上报一条 `DEADLINE_EXCEEDED` 诊断。
`gracefulTimeoutMs?: number` —— 优雅阶段自己的预算，会被事务共享的绝对 `deadlineAt` 进一步封顶（取两者较小值）。
`force: (context) => void | PromiseLike<void>`（必填）—— 必须无条件完成，不得依赖任何前置条件。

`gcFallback?: boolean` —— 异步 scope 可注册尽力而为的 `FinalizationRegistry` 兜底，显式释放（`dispose()`/`release()`）会 unregister。存活的 scope 强引用其资源，因此不会单独回收某个仍被 scope 拥有的资源；它只能作为遗忘整个 owner 后的兜底，不能替代显式 dispose。同步 scope 接受此共享 descriptor 字段，但不注册 finalizer。
`custom?` —— 逃生舱：一旦提供，完全接管释放，`graceful`/`force` 被忽略。

blocks.text: `IReleaseContext`（回调收到的第一参数）：`signal: IAbortSignal`（容器进入 closing 时中止）、`deadlineAt: number | undefined`、`scheduler?: IScheduler`（产出 `deadlineAt` 的时间域，缺省 `systemScheduler`）、`report(error: unknown): void`（诊断通道，自身 throw/rejection 交 utils 共享宿主异常队列）、`disposer?: IDisposerContext`。由 `LifecycleScope` 驱动的 disposer 才有 `disposer.join()`；该显式 owner self-join operation 在同步调用及任意 await、microtask、Promise chain、nested helper 或 timer 后都立即抛 `SCOPE_REENTRANT_DISPOSE`，不返回 outer disposal Promise。没有 scope owner 的 generic `createDisposeTransaction()` 不伪造此 capability；不要捕获 scope 后在 disposer 中直接调用 `scope.dispose()` 绕过 context。

blocks.code:
function createLifecycleScope(options?: ILifecycleScopeOptions): ILifecycleScope

type ILifecycleScopeOptions = {
  readonly errorPolicy?: 'throw' | 'collect' | 'report' | 'firstError' // 默认 'throw'
  readonly report?: (error: unknown) => void
  readonly deadlineAt?: number
  readonly scheduler?: IScheduler // 默认 systemScheduler
}

type ILifecycleScope = ILifecycleOwner & {
  readonly lifecycle: 'open' | 'closing' | 'terminal'
  own<T>(resource: T, descriptor: IReleaseDescriptor): T
  release(resource: unknown): boolean
  close(): void
  dispose(): Promise<readonly ICollectedError[]>
  [Symbol.asyncDispose](): Promise<void> // await using；丢弃收集到的错误结果
}

blocks.text: 通用异步所有权容器：
边界行为：

items: `own(resource, descriptor)`：容器处于 `closing`/`terminal` 时抛 `SCOPE_CLOSED`/`SCOPE_TERMINAL`；在 disposer 内部重入调用抛 `SCOPE_REENTRANT_OWN`；descriptor 形状非法（`order`/`custom`/`graceful`/`gracefulTimeoutMs`/`force`，规则同 dispose 时的 descriptor 校验）时在注册时就抛 `INVALID_OPTION`，访问器抛错则原样抛出。
`release(resource)`：反注册但不释放（调用方已自行释放），返回是否找到并移除了该条目；若曾设置 `gcFallback`，同时 unregister 对应的 `FinalizationRegistry` 条目。
`close()`：同步、幂等；`open → closing`。

`dispose()`：逆序（LIFO）释放全部已注册资源；并发多次调用复用同一个 Promise；需要在 disposer 中表达 owner self-join 时使用 `context.disposer.join()`，该操作抛 `SCOPE_REENTRANT_DISPOSE` 且不改变 canonical Promise；容器已 `terminal` 时仍返回首次 dispose Promise，保留原结果或 rejection。`errorPolicy: 'collect'` 时返回值为收集到的 `ICollectedError[]`；其余三种策略要么抛出要么内部上报，返回空数组。
提供 `[Symbol.asyncDispose](): Promise<void>`，可直接用于 `await using`（TypeScript 需包含 `ESNext.Disposable` 类型库）。

blocks.text: 纯同步容器：

blocks.code:
const scope = createSyncLifecycleScope()
scope.own(node, { syncSafe: true, force: () => node.detach() })
scope.close()
const failures = scope.dispose() // 同步返回

blocks.text: 约束与边界：

items: 每个 descriptor 必须显式 `syncSafe: true`，否则 `own()` 在注册时（不是释放时）就抛 `SCOPE_SYNC_VIOLATION`。
descriptor 形状校验与异步版本相同：`order` 非有限数、`force` 缺失等非法值在 `own()` 时抛 `INVALID_OPTION`。
不能 `own()` 一个 `LifecycleScope`/`ProvisionalScope` 实例（内部品牌检测），命中同样抛 `SCOPE_SYNC_VIOLATION`。
某个 callback（`custom`/`graceful`/`force`）若返回 thenable，在释放当次同步探测到并抛 `SCOPE_SYNC_VIOLATION`（`graceful` 违规时会继续跑 `force`，`force`/`custom` 违规则该项失败计入当前错误策略）。
降级链与异步版本相同（`custom` → 否则 `graceful` → `force`），但没有超时竞速——没有可等待的对象。
`release()`/`close()` 语义与异步版本一致；`dispose()` 幂等，二次调用返回 `[]`；在 disposer 内部重入抛 `SCOPE_REENTRANT_DISPOSE`。
提供 `[Symbol.dispose](): void`，可直接用于 `using`（TypeScript 需包含 `ESNext.Disposable` 类型库）。

blocks.text: 独立运行单个 descriptor 的完整降级链（`custom` → 否则 `graceful`（带超时竞速）→ `force`），不经过完整事务，常用于测试或自定义编排：

`descriptor`、`context` 均必填，`context` 无可选项——必须直接构造完整对象。descriptor 执行及准入失败进入返回的错误数组（成功为空数组）；context getter 或非法 deadline 等 context 准入失败会使 Promise reject；`graceful` 超时时会通过 `context.report` 上报一条诊断（`DEADLINE_EXCEEDED` 或空转到 `force`），`force` 失败时额外通过 `report` 上报一条 `RELEASE_FORCE_FAILED` 标签的错误（原始错误仍原样进入返回数组）。
编排多个资源的释放，`order` 弱排序或 `plan` 强序列二选一，同一实例不能混用：
边界行为：

items: `{ kind: 'order' }`：按每个 item 的 `descriptor.order`（缺省 `0`）降序分组释放，稳定排序保留同序调用方给定的相对顺序；只在此模式读取 `order`。
`{ kind: 'plan' }`：严格按 `items` 给定顺序执行，从不读取 `order` 字段。
`signal?`：转发进每个 item 的 `context.signal`；`run()` 开始时自动镜像调用方传入信号的中止状态；无 `signal` 时 item 收到一个永不中止的惰性信号。
`deadlineAt`/`scheduler`：本次 `run()` 内所有 item 共享，不逐 item 重算。
`pending?`：全部 item 释放完后仅一次调用 `pending.drain()` 等待其触发的在途工作排空（典型传 `createPendingTracker()`）。
descriptor 校验（`order`/`custom`/`graceful`/`gracefulTimeoutMs`/`force` 的类型与访问）逐项独立进行——一个 item 的非法 descriptor（贴 `INVALID_OPTION` 码）不阻断其余 item 的释放，会作为该 item 的失败计入错误策略。
`errorPolicy` 语义同 `createErrorCollector`；`throw` 策略下单错保留原生实例并给未分类错误附 `SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED`，primitive 通过 cause 包装；已有合法外部身份不变。多错聚合为携带 `SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED` 码的 `AggregateError`。

blocks.text: `mergeCleanupResults(values)` 接受 cleanup result 或其 PromiseLike 数组，等待每个结果的 `physicalCompletion` 链，返回冻结的 `{ cleanupErrors }`。错误按输入顺序及各输入的当前/迟到顺序归并；源 Promise 拒绝也保留为原错误，不会丢弃其它分支。不使用 realm-local `instanceof Promise`，跨 realm Promise 与 thenable 都可用。

`ICleanupResult<TError>` 是 lifecycle、PluginHost 与 Tray 的共同边界：当前 `cleanupErrors` 与后续 `physicalCompletion` 不重复包含同一轮错误。领域的 logical terminal、ok、cleanupComplete 等标志仍归各调用方。不要把全量错误列表放进 physical continuation，否则会重复计数。

`mergeCleanupResults` observes current cleanup snapshots and their later physical continuations. Each continuation contains only newly observed errors. It accepts PromiseLike values across realms, retains original rejection identities, and merges branches in input order without discarding successful or failed siblings. Domain state stays with its owner.
用于“同步启动全部 disposer，但异步统一等待”的领域容器。Ledger 是 pending、raw error 与 terminal 的唯一事实源；调用方仍负责生成顺序计划、清空领域 registry，以及把 raw errors 投影成自己的 throw/report/aggregate 契约。
状态和 identity：

items: 初始 `open`；`start()` 不改变 lifecycle。
首次 `seal()` 同步进入 `closing`，冻结当时已经观察到的全部错误，并返回唯一 outcome；重复 `seal()` 返回同一对象，`outcome.physicalCompletion` 也保持同一 Promise。
已 seal 且 `pending === 0` 时进入 `terminal`；否则最后一个 thenable settle 后进入 `terminal`。`whenTerminal()` 只表达 terminal 等待，不承诺 Promise 对象 identity。
合法 thenable 永不 settle 时保持 `closing`；Ledger 不自造 timeout、abort、retry 或强制 terminal。

blocks.text: Callback 与 thenable：

items: `start()` 先校验 `source` 为 string、`callback` 为 function；非法输入同步抛 `INVALID_OPTION`，且不调用 callback。
callback 同步 throw 或读取 `.then` getter throw：记录进 seal 时的 `cleanupErrors` 快照；`start()` 不重抛 item failure，因此调用方仍能启动后续 item。
thenable 的 `.then` 只读取一次，并以原 thenable 为 receiver 调用；resolve/reject first-settlement-wins。Rejection按 settlement observation order进入最终 ledger。
每条错误是冻结的 `{ source, error }`；原始 `error` identity不被 Ledger替换。`physicalCompletion` 因 item failure也不会 reject，避免 Ledger抢走领域错误政策。

blocks.text: 重入和关闭边界：

items: 当前 item callback/thenable probe 尚未结束时重入 `start()` 或 `seal()`，同步抛 `SCOPE_REENTRANT_OWN`（`disposalLedgerReentrant` 文案）；外层 `start()` 把它当作当前 item 的同步 failure收集。
seal 后再 `start()` 同步抛 `SCOPE_CLOSED`（`disposalLedgerClosed` 文案），不调用新 callback。
Ledger 没有 rollback：进入 closing 后只能等待 admitted thenables settle。

blocks.text: 错误政策边界：Ledger 固定采用 raw `collect`。`firstError` 是最终 ledger 的第一条 observation；`throw`、`report`、`AggregateError` message/source/code和reporter failure containment全部属于调用 adapter，不应反向写入 Ledger。

  type IGenerationController,
  type IGenerationControllerOptions,
  type IGenerationRequest,

} from '@migaia/lifecycle'

function createGenerationController(options?: IGenerationControllerOptions): IGenerationController

type IGenerationControllerOptions = {
  readonly parentSignal?: IAbortSignal
  readonly onSuperseded?: (info: ILifecycleError) => void
  readonly scheduler?: IScheduler // 默认 systemScheduler
  readonly report?: (error: unknown) => void
}

type IGenerationToken = object

type IGenerationRequest = {
  readonly generation: number
  readonly token: IGenerationToken
  readonly signal: IAbortSignal
}

type IGenerationController = {
  readonly generation: number
  readonly disposed: boolean
  begin(options?: { readonly timeoutMs?: number }): IGenerationRequest
  isCurrent(token: IGenerationToken): boolean
  complete(token: IGenerationToken): boolean
  supersede(reason?: unknown): void
  adopt<T>(
    token: IGenerationToken,
    value: T,
    release: (value: T) => void | PromiseLike<void>,
    onReleaseError?: (error: unknown) => void
  ): boolean

blocks.text: 代数 + 每代一个 `AbortSignal`，新一代自动使旧一代失效：
边界行为：

items: `begin(options?)`：使当前活跃代（若存在）立即失效（触发其 `signal` 中止），`generation` 自增，返回新的 `{ generation, token, signal }`。`options.timeoutMs?` 非法（非有限/负数）抛 `INVALID_OPTION`；超过该毫秒数后当前代的 `signal` 自动中止。控制器已 `dispose()` 后调用抛 `GENERATION_DISPOSED`。
`isCurrent(token)`：`token` 是否仍是当前代；`dispose()` 之后恒为 `false`。
`supersede(reason?)`：作废当前代（其 `signal` 中止）但控制器本身仍可用，之后 `begin()` 仍能开新代；对已 `dispose()` 的控制器调用是空操作。

`complete(token)`：只释放匹配的当前代，返回 true 并使 token 不再 current；先清 timer、再移除 parent listener，保持 signal 未中止。stale/disposed token 返回 false，不影响当前代。cleanup 失败仍以原 `GENERATION_CANCELLATION_FAILED` 保留原 cause，失败后 token 已作废；后续 `begin()` 仍可用。真正取消继续使用 `supersede`/parent/timeout/dispose，保持原 signal 与 reason。

`adopt(token, value, release, onReleaseError?)`：`token` 仍是当前代时返回 `true`，`value` 留给调用方；否则调用 `release(value)` 回收并返回 `false`——`release` 本身抛出/reject 只会经 `onReleaseError` 上报，绝不反过来污染"当前是哪一代"这一状态（不会抛出、不会重新计入错误策略）。若提供了 `onSuperseded`，在过期路径上先额外触发一次携带 `GENERATION_SUPERSEDED` 码的诊断信息（非失败信号）。
`dispose(reason?)`：终态；之后 `begin()` 恒抛 `GENERATION_DISPOSED`，`isCurrent()` 恒 `false`。
`parentSignal` 中止时，当前活跃代同步中止（清理 timer、移除 parent listener、abort 自身 controller）；清理过程中任一步失败会聚合为 `GENERATION_CANCELLATION_FAILED`。

import {
  createQuiescenceTracker,
  createStringLeaseRegistry,
  createObjectLeaseRegistry,
  createPendingTracker,
  type IQuiescenceTracker,
  type ILeaseRegistry,
  type IPendingTracker
} from '@migaia/lifecycle'

function createQuiescenceTracker<TKey extends object>(): IQuiescenceTracker<TKey>
function createStringLeaseRegistry(): IQuiescenceTracker<string>

type IQuiescenceTracker<TKey> = {
  retain(key: TKey): IDisposer // IDisposer = () => void
  count(key: TKey): number
  whenZero(key: TKey): Promise<void> // 严格独占等待
  whenZeroOnce(key: TKey): Promise<void> // 非独占等待
  seal(key: TKey): void
  isSealed(key: TKey): boolean
  forget(key: TKey): boolean
}

blocks.text: 按 key 计数的租约追踪：对象键用 `WeakMap`（自动 GC），字符串键用 `Map`（归零后自动清理未 seal 的条目）：
两者均无构造参数。边界行为：

items: `retain(key)`：已 `seal(key)` 的 key 上调用抛 `QUIESCENCE_SEALED`；返回的释放函数重复调用幂等（只在首次调用时递减计数）。
`whenZero(key)`：必须先 `seal(key)`，否则同步抛 `QUIESCENCE_UNSEALED_WAIT`（不是返回 rejected Promise）；已归零时立即 resolve。
`whenZeroOnce(key)`：不要求 seal，随时可等待"下一次归零"，不阻塞新 `retain()`。
`seal(key)`：幂等，标记该 key 之后拒绝新租约。
`forget(key)`：仅当计数为 0 且没有任何等待者时才移除该 key 的已存储状态。返回值表示本次是否实际删除了状态；状态原本不存在或已被自动清除时也返回 `false`，不表示计数仍大于 0。
一个未 seal 且归零的 key（字符串键）会被自动从底层 `Map` 中删除，避免长期驻留；已 `seal` 的 key 的"已 seal"事实会保留。

blocks.text: 与上面完全同一引擎的别名（内部就是分别调用 `createQuiescenceTracker()`/`createStringLeaseRegistry()`），供领域友好命名的调用点使用；无构造参数。
只暴露 `track`/`drain`/`size` 的窄接口，用于追踪并排空在途 Promise（内部基于一个字符串键 `createStringLeaseRegistry()`）：

blocks.code:
const pending = createPendingTracker()
pending.track(doWork()) // 原样返回传入的 promise
await pending.drain() // 等到 size 归零；排空期间新增的 track() 不会被漏计（内部循环 whenZeroOnce）
pending.size // 当前在途数量

blocks.text: 无构造参数。`track(promise)` 结算后（无论 resolve 还是 reject）自动释放内部租约；`drain()` 永不抛出（内部忽略释放函数自身的异常，`release` 本身也不会抛）；`drain()` 内部循环调用 `whenZeroOnce()`，因此排空期间新 `track()` 进来的 promise 也会被等到。
构造期两阶段所有权：资源先暂存这里，最终要么 `commitTo(parent)` 转移给真正的 owner，要么 `rollback()` 释放，二选一、只能选一次：
边界行为：

items: `own(resource, descriptor)`：已 commit/rollback 后调用抛 `PROVISIONAL_SETTLED`；descriptor 形状非法时抛 `INVALID_OPTION`（不读取 `order`，commit 时由 parent 的 `own()` 校验）。

`commitTo(parent)`：按注册顺序逐个调用 `parent.own(resource, descriptor)`；某项失败时，已转移给 parent 的部分保留在 parent 名下，尚未转移的部分由本作用域逆序释放并 await 完成后才重新抛出原错误——不会有资源被两边都不持有，也不会有资源留给"none"；若失败原因是 `parent` 已处于 `closing`/`terminal`（错误码为 `SCOPE_CLOSED`/`SCOPE_TERMINAL`），额外包一层 `PROVISIONAL_PARENT_CLOSED`，原错误仍在 `cause`，遗留资源的释放失败列表挂在 `errors`。
`rollback()`：逆序释放全部已注册资源，单错保留附码原生实例，primitive 通过 cause 包装；多错聚合为携带 `SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED` 码的 `AggregateError`；幂等——并发/重复调用复用同一个 settle Promise。
重复 rollback 复用首次 Promise，包括其 rejection；成功 commit 后 rollback、重复 commit 或 rollback 后 commit 才以 `PROVISIONAL_SETTLED` 拒绝（rollback 返回 rejected Promise）。
`parentSignal` 中止时（构造时已中止，或之后中止），`signal` 同步跟随中止，但不会自动触发 rollback/commit——仍需调用方显式二选一。

blocks.text: 严格 FIFO 串行队列，无并发池，带可选的入队 SLA 看门狗：
边界行为：

items: `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs`：数字表示任务在队列中等待超过这个时长即被移出队列并以 `QUEUE_ADMISSION_TIMEOUT` reject；`undefined`（默认）只诊断、从不因排队超时而拒绝；`false` 连诊断计时器也不开。
`admissionDiagnosticMs`：仅在 `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs` 为 `undefined` 且提供了 `onAdmissionDiagnostic` 时生效的诊断阈值；`false` 关闭诊断计时器。

`owner`：用于自依赖检测——同一 `owner` 在自己正在运行时又向同一队列提交新任务，会立即以 `QUEUE_SELF_DEPENDENCY` reject（因为 FIFO 队列不可能在当前任务完成前跑新任务）。这是部分防护：正在运行的任务提交一个不同/无 `owner` 的任务并原地 `await` 它同样会死锁，但没有可靠信号能检测这种情况，因此不拦截；安全模式是提交后续任务而不在当前任务内 `await` 它。
`size`：只读，等于排队数加运行中的 0/1。

内部/自定义 scheduler 实现复用的边界解析函数：`resolveScheduler(value)` 对非法值抛 `SCHEDULER_INVALID` 文案的 `INVALID_OPTION` 错误（而不是像 `snapshotScheduler` 那样返回 `undefined`）；`resolveSchedulerOption(options, fallback?)` 读取 `options.scheduler`，未提供时返回 `fallback`（若调用形态未传 `fallback` 则返回 `undefined`），读取该属性本身抛错时抛 `TypeError`（`INVALID_OPTION`）。
本包委托当前宿主的原生 `AbortController`，返回真实 host instance（结构上与 DOM/Node 的 `AbortSignal` 兼容，可互相传递）：

无构造参数，也不接受 custom factory。实际对象由当前 realm 的 host-owned `globalThis.AbortController` 构造；lifecycle 不返回 facade、Proxy 或自建 EventTarget。宿主 constructor 缺失、getter throw、不可构造、构造失败或结果不满足最小 controller/signal shape时，抛保留原始 cause 的 `ENV_UNSUPPORTED`。
需要注意的行为：

items: `abort()` 与 `abort(undefined)` 使用宿主默认 reason，通常是原生 `DOMException`（name 为 `AbortError`），而不是 `undefined`。
non-`undefined` explicit reason保持 `===` identity；把 structural parent signal 的 `undefined` reason转发给native child时，同样规范化为宿主 `AbortError`。
重复 `abort()` 幂等，不覆盖第一次固化的 reason。
外部 listener throw走宿主 EventTarget error channel；`try/catch controller.abort()` 不能同步捕获它，lifecycle也不再提供 `ABORT_LISTENER_FAILED`。

Lifecycle 自己登记的 parent/cancellation callback 经过 module-private observed-subscription：处理 already-aborted、registration-time abort、post-registration recheck和幂等remove，并把自身 callback/read/cleanup failure交给对应 operation的collect/report边界。它不代理、枚举或捕获同一 signal 上的外部 listener。

blocks.text: 如果业务需要旧式“listener错误由调用 abort 的栈聚合抛出”，应使用业务自己拥有的回调编排器；不要包裹或 monkey-patch native `AbortSignal`。
等到绝对截止时间为止，从不取消被等待的任务：

blocks.code: const won = await boundedWait(task, deadlineAt) // true=task 先完成；false=截止时间先到（task 仍在跑）

blocks.text: `task`、`deadlineAt` 均必填（`deadlineAt` 是绝对时刻，经 `validateSchedulerTime` 校验）。无论超时与否都会挂一个 `.catch()` 观察 `task`，避免它日后 reject 变成未处理拒绝；`deadlineAt` 已经过去时立即返回 `false`（仍会先观察 `task`）。

const terminal = createTerminalController()
terminal.close() // open → closing，幂等
terminal.forceTerminal() // 直接进 terminal，resolve whenTerminal()
await terminal.whenTerminal()

`abortableDelay(scheduler, ms, signal, reportCleanup?)` 从 `@migaia/lifecycle` 根入口导入。 `scheduler` 负责计时，`ms` 必须有限且非负；`signal` 可以传 `undefined`。 返回 `Promise<boolean>`：到期为 `true`，abort 事件先到为 `false`；调用方决定取消是否应变成领域 AbortError。 监听器注册与 scheduler 接纳结束前不提交同步 callback 的结果；接纳失败保持 primary，原始错误实例或 cause 链可追溯。 任务句柄最多 cancel 一次，abort 监听由 canonical observed-subscription 管理。
清理失败默认使 wait 拒绝；提供 `reportCleanup(error)` 后，清理失败走该观察渠道，不替换已完成或已取消的结果。 注册或调度失败仍拒绝，`DELAY_FAILED` 保留 native Error 的身份与 stack，不能附加身份时用 cause 保留原值。 无效时长或 cleanup reporter 在接纳前以 `INVALID_OPTION` 拒绝。

`boundedWait(task, deadlineAt, { scheduler, reportCleanup? })` 仍负责绝对截止时间与任务竞争，不会取消 task。 它的默认清理失败行为不变；可选 `reportCleanup` 允许 logger flush 把 timer 清理失败作为诊断，保留任务或 deadline winner。 批处理 debounce、health 周期调度与预算授予定时器不等同于一次性相对延时，不强行转换其 owner 语义。

`@migaia/lifecycle/scope` 是异步 `createLifecycleScope` 的窄入口；同步与 provisional scope 从 root 导入 `createSyncLifecycleScope` / `createProvisionalScope`。包不提供第二套 scope 实现。generation/quiescence 子路径直接映射各自 canonical owner，未构建的同名 barrel 已删除。

blocks.text: `createLifecycleScope`、`createSyncLifecycleScope`、`createProvisionalScope` 和 `createMutationQueue` 返回的对象，方法都定义在原型上，必须通过对象调用（`scope.own(...)`、`queue.enqueue(...)`）。把方法解构出来单独调用（`const { own } = scope`）不受支持。
`own()` 校验 descriptor 时会保存一份快照，释放时使用的就是这份快照：注册之后再修改 descriptor 对象，或 getter 之后返回不同的值，都不会影响释放。provisional scope 在 `commitTo(parent)` 时仍把原 descriptor 交给 `parent.own()`，由父 scope 自己校验和快照。
options（`errorPolicy`、`report`、`deadlineAt`、`scheduler`、`onAdmissionDiagnostic` 等）只在创建时读取一次，之后不会再读。
释放回调收到的 `context.signal` 在第一次读取时才创建（已经处于 aborted 状态，reason 为 `SCOPE_CLOSED`）；provisional scope 没有传 `parentSignal` 时，它的 `signal` 也是第一次读取时才创建。不读取 signal 的释放回调不会产生 AbortController。

blocks.text: `createLifecycleUnit` 及其 option/result types 不再从 module 导出；应用使用 `createGenerationController` 管理过期任务，并由领域层持有加载状态。`createStringQuiescenceTracker` 改用有真实消费方的 `createStringLeaseRegistry`。`validateSchedulerTime`、`validateSchedulerDelay`、`tagLifecycleError`、`createLifecycleRangeError` 只供包内部使用，root 与 leaf 均不再暴露。`/scheduler` 公开 snapshot/resolve 准入工具。错误构造器与 scheduler 算术 helper 均已收回内部，不提供兼容 alias；业务错误使用所属包的身份。

Generation controller 的 `report?: (error: unknown) => void` 负责没有调用方接收的失败：adopt 未传 onReleaseError 时的过期资源释放错误，以及异步 timeout 的 timer/parent-listener 清理错误。reporter 自身的 throw/rejection 交 utils 共享宿主异常队列；省略时这些诊断不外发。

`resolveScheduler`/`snapshotScheduler` preserve an admitted `IScheduler.defer` alongside now/schedule. Later method replacement cannot redirect registered owners; raw getters are read during admission. Missing required methods still make snapshotScheduler return undefined, while getter failures preserve cause and a supplied malformed deferred method throws a coded TypeError. This does not add a second clock or alter deadline cancellation. A legacy object may omit defer and use the utils deferred helper's zero-delay fallback.
中文

The hardest part of asynchronous code to get right is the ending: what closes first and what closes last, what happens when cleanup fails halfway, what to do when an old request answers late, and whether to wait for unfinished work and for how long. `@migaia/lifecycle` turns those ending rules into small tools you can combine, so shutdown, cancellation and replacement stay correct under concurrency. It depends on neither the DOM nor Node, and works in browsers, Node, Bun, Deno and Workers.

With a scope, release order follows registration order, one failure does not stop the others, and every wait has a deadline. A new resource needs a single `own()` call where it is created, instead of another line in the shutdown code.

items: Even when one cleanup throws, every other resource is still released. The original error reaches you with a `code` attached (several failures become one `AggregateError`), and no later error hides it. You can also collect failures into an array (`collect`) or pass them to a logger (`report`).
Even when `dispose()` is called several times at once, release runs only once. Every caller receives the same Promise, so no connection is closed twice.

Release order is the reverse of registration order by default. The pool registered first closes last; the service registered later, which depends on it, closes first. You can also order by priority, or try a graceful close first and force it after a timeout.

A late answer to an old request never overwrites a newer result. Starting a new request aborts the old one's signal, and a resource the old request already obtained can be handed to a release function.
Every wait has a limit. `boundedWait` returns at its deadline, so one stuck task cannot hang the whole shutdown; it does not cancel that task on its own.
Initialisation either reclaims or hands over everything. Resources created before a failure are released in reverse order; on success they move to a long-lived scope in one step.

It works with native `using`. The async scope supports `await using` and the sync scope supports `using`. Compared with hand-written `try/finally`, you get concurrency-safe release, error policies and deadlines.

sections.heading: Use only the latest request's result

blocks.text: Call `begin()` before each request to get that request's `token` and `signal`. A newer `begin()` makes the previous request stale and aborts its `signal`. When a result arrives, confirm with `isCurrent(token)` that it still belongs to the latest request before updating the page.
Output:

blocks.code: page shows: [ 'results for ab' ]

blocks.text: `begin({ timeoutMs })` adds a timeout that aborts the request's `signal` when it expires. If a stale request already obtained something that must be released (a connection, say), use `adopt(token, value, release)`: it returns `true` and leaves the value to you when the result is still current, and otherwise calls `release(value)` and returns `false`.

sections.heading: Clean up together when a page closes

blocks.text: Create a scope when a page opens and register every subscription, timer and connection in it; call `dispose()` once when the page closes. Release runs in reverse registration order, so registering the connection before the subscription that depends on it means the subscription is removed first and the connection closed last.
Output:

blocks.code:
message received
heartbeat timer cleared
message subscription removed
connection closed

blocks.text: Calling `own()` after `dispose()` throws `SCOPE_TERMINAL`, so nothing can attach to a page that is already gone. When every cleanup is synchronous (DOM listeners, for instance), use `createSyncLifecycleScope()`: its `dispose()` finishes immediately and it supports the `using` syntax.

sections.heading: Reclaim what was created when initialisation fails

blocks.text: When initialisation has several steps, register what each step creates in a provisional scope first. When every step succeeds, call `commitTo(app)` to hand everything to the long-lived scope at once; when a step fails, call `rollback()` to release what was already created, in reverse order.
Output:

blocks.code:
reclaimed: cache closed
  reclaimed: database disconnected
install failed: route conflict
plugin installed
app shutting down:
  reclaimed: cache closed
  reclaimed: database disconnected

blocks.text: `commitTo()` and `rollback()` are mutually exclusive and may be chosen only once. If the target scope starts closing during the hand-over, what was already handed over stays with the target, the rest is released by the provisional scope, and `PROVISIONAL_PARENT_CLOSED` is thrown with the original error on `cause`.

When two saves are sent almost at once, the slower, older one can reach the server last and overwrite newer content. `createMutationQueue()` runs changes one at a time: a later save starts only after the earlier one has finished.
Output:

blocks.code:
without a queue the server keeps: draft v1
with a queue the server keeps: draft v2

blocks.text: The queue never runs tasks concurrently. A task that submits another task to the same queue and awaits it would wait forever; pass `{ owner }` with each task and that case fails at once with `QUEUE_SELF_DEPENDENCY` instead of hanging.

sections.heading: One cleanup fails, the rest still run

blocks.text: The default error policy is `throw`: every resource is released first, then the failure is thrown. With one failure, the thrown value is the original error itself, with `source` and `code` added; with several failures, an `AggregateError` is thrown and every original error is in `errors`.
Output:

blocks.code:
timer cleared
socket closed
dispose() failed: cache file is locked (SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED)
scope state: terminal

blocks.text: If shutdown should not throw, use `createLifecycleScope({ errorPolicy: 'collect' })` and `dispose()` returns the failures as an array, or `{ errorPolicy: 'report', report }` to send each failure to a logger.

blocks.text: These types are exported from the root entry and create no runtime state:

items: `IDisposer`: a synchronous release function held by the caller; it should be idempotent.

`ILifecycleOwner`: anything that accepts a resource together with an explicit `IReleaseDescriptor`. `ProvisionalScope.commitTo()` depends on it, so both sync and async scopes can be the target even though their `dispose()` shapes differ.
`ILifecycleState`: whether a resource container is still open; loading states belong to whoever owns the loading.

`ICollectedError`: a failure plus the `source` label the caller supplied. Both fields are readonly at compile time; the collector does not freeze each item. An unclassified native error gets a code attached in place, a primitive is wrapped, and an error that already carries a valid source and code keeps it. The raw ledger does not go through this projection.
`IErrorPolicy`: the four ways release errors can surface. New callers normally choose `throw`, `collect` or `report`; `firstError` exists for callers that need first-error-wins behaviour.
`IReleaseContext` and `IReleaseDescriptor` are described in full in the next section; other named types appear next to their factory.

blocks.text: Two independent concerns are at work: whether the container is still open (`open → closing → terminal`, driven by `close()` and `dispose()`), and releasing the resources themselves. `close()` is always synchronous and idempotent and never calls your code; `dispose()` is always asynchronous.

sections.heading: IReleaseDescriptor: how a resource is released

blocks.code:
type IReleaseDescriptor = {
  readonly syncSafe?: boolean
  readonly order?: number
  readonly graceful?: (context: IReleaseContext) => void | PromiseLike<void>
  readonly gracefulTimeoutMs?: number
  readonly force: (context: IReleaseContext) => void | PromiseLike<void>
  readonly gcFallback?: boolean
  readonly custom?: (context: IReleaseContext) => void | PromiseLike<void>
}

blocks.text: Fields:

items: `syncSafe?: boolean`: declares that `SyncLifecycleScope` may accept this descriptor. It does not change the static type of `LifecycleScope`; whether a scope is sync or async depends on which factory created it, never on descriptor content.
`order?: number`: release ordering key, `0` when omitted. It only applies in a `DisposeTransaction` running in `order` mode, where larger values are released first.

`graceful?`: a gentle release. When it times out, the scope stops waiting for it (without cancelling it) and moves on to `force`. If `graceful` throws (as opposed to timing out), `force` still runs. A `graceful` that returns synchronously counts as a completed release: even if it overran its budget, `force` does not run, and one `DEADLINE_EXCEEDED` diagnostic goes to `context.report`.
`gracefulTimeoutMs?: number`: the graceful phase's own budget, further capped by the transaction's shared absolute `deadlineAt` (the smaller wins).
`force: (context) => void | PromiseLike<void>` (required): must complete unconditionally and must not depend on any precondition.

`gcFallback?: boolean`: an async scope may register a best-effort `FinalizationRegistry` fallback, which explicit release (`dispose()` or `release()`) unregisters. A live scope holds strong references to its resources, so this never collects one resource while its scope is reachable; it only helps when the whole owner is forgotten and never replaces explicit disposal. A sync scope accepts the field but registers no finalizer.
`custom?`: an escape hatch. When present it takes over the release completely and `graceful`/`force` are ignored.

blocks.text: `IReleaseContext` (the first argument of every callback): `signal: IAbortSignal` (aborts when the container starts closing), `deadlineAt: number | undefined`, `scheduler?: IScheduler` (the clock that produced `deadlineAt`; `systemScheduler` by default), `report(error: unknown): void` (a diagnostic channel; its own throws and rejections go to the shared host error queue from `@migaia/utils`), and `disposer?: IDisposerContext`. Only callbacks driven by a `LifecycleScope` receive `disposer.join()`. That explicit "wait for my own owner" operation throws `SCOPE_REENTRANT_DISPOSE` immediately, whether called synchronously or after any await, microtask, Promise chain, nested helper or timer, and never returns the outer disposal Promise. A generic `createDisposeTransaction()` without a scope owner does not fake this capability. Do not capture the scope and call `scope.dispose()` inside a disposer to get around it.

function createLifecycleScope(options?: ILifecycleScopeOptions): ILifecycleScope

type ILifecycleScopeOptions = {
  readonly errorPolicy?: 'throw' | 'collect' | 'report' | 'firstError' // default 'throw'
  readonly report?: (error: unknown) => void
  readonly deadlineAt?: number
  readonly scheduler?: IScheduler // default systemScheduler
}

type ILifecycleScope = ILifecycleOwner & {
  readonly lifecycle: 'open' | 'closing' | 'terminal'
  own<T>(resource: T, descriptor: IReleaseDescriptor): T
  release(resource: unknown): boolean
  close(): void
  dispose(): Promise<readonly ICollectedError[]>
  [Symbol.asyncDispose](): Promise<void> // await using; discards the collected errors
}

blocks.text: The general-purpose async ownership container:
Edge cases:

items: `own(resource, descriptor)`: throws `SCOPE_CLOSED` / `SCOPE_TERMINAL` when the container is `closing` / `terminal`, and `SCOPE_REENTRANT_OWN` when called from inside one of its own disposers. An invalid descriptor shape (`order`, `custom`, `graceful`, `gracefulTimeoutMs`, `force`, checked by the same rules as at dispose time) throws `INVALID_OPTION` at registration; an accessor that throws is rethrown unchanged.

`release(resource)`: unregisters a resource without releasing it (the caller already released it) and returns whether an entry was found and removed. If the entry used `gcFallback`, its `FinalizationRegistry` entry is unregistered too.
`close()`: synchronous and idempotent; `open → closing`.

`dispose()`: releases every registered resource in reverse (LIFO) order. Concurrent calls share one Promise. To express "wait for my own owner" inside a disposer, use `context.disposer.join()`, which throws `SCOPE_REENTRANT_DISPOSE` without disturbing the shared Promise. Once the container is `terminal`, `dispose()` still returns the first dispose Promise with its original result or rejection. With `errorPolicy: 'collect'` the result is the collected `ICollectedError[]`; the other three policies throw or report internally and return an empty array.
`[Symbol.asyncDispose](): Promise<void>` makes the scope usable with `await using` (TypeScript needs the `ESNext.Disposable` lib).

blocks.text: A purely synchronous container:

blocks.code:
const scope = createSyncLifecycleScope()
scope.own(node, { syncSafe: true, force: () => node.detach() })
scope.close()
const failures = scope.dispose() // returns synchronously

blocks.text: Rules and edge cases:

items: Every descriptor must state `syncSafe: true`; otherwise `own()` throws `SCOPE_SYNC_VIOLATION` at registration, not at release.
Descriptor shape checks match the async version: an `order` that is not a finite number, a missing `force` and similar mistakes throw `INVALID_OPTION` from `own()`.
A `LifecycleScope` or `ProvisionalScope` instance cannot be owned (detected by an internal brand); trying throws `SCOPE_SYNC_VIOLATION`.

A callback (`custom`, `graceful` or `force`) that returns a thenable is detected synchronously at release and reported as `SCOPE_SYNC_VIOLATION`. A violating `graceful` still falls through to `force`; a violating `force` or `custom` counts as that item's failure under the current error policy.
The fallback chain matches the async version (`custom`, otherwise `graceful` then `force`) but without timeouts, since there is nothing to wait for.
`release()` and `close()` behave as in the async version. `dispose()` is idempotent and returns `[]` on later calls; calling it from inside a disposer throws `SCOPE_REENTRANT_DISPOSE`.
`[Symbol.dispose](): void` makes the scope usable with `using` (TypeScript needs the `ESNext.Disposable` lib).

blocks.text: Runs one descriptor's full fallback chain (`custom`, otherwise `graceful` with its timeout race, then `force`) without a full transaction. Useful in tests and custom orchestration:

Both arguments are required and `context` has no optional fields: build the complete object. Failures while admitting or running the descriptor end up in the returned array (empty on success). A context that cannot be admitted (a throwing getter, an invalid deadline) rejects the Promise. A `graceful` timeout sends a diagnostic to `context.report` (`DEADLINE_EXCEEDED`, or a note that it fell through to `force`). A failing `force` additionally reports an error labelled `RELEASE_FORCE_FAILED`, while the original error still goes into the returned array unchanged.
Coordinates the release of several resources, either by priority (`order`) or in an exact sequence (`plan`). One transaction uses one mode:
Edge cases:

items: `{ kind: 'order' }`: groups items by `descriptor.order` (default `0`) and releases larger values first; the sort is stable, so items with the same value keep the order you gave. `order` is read only in this mode.
`{ kind: 'plan' }`: runs `items` exactly in the given order and never reads `order`.

`signal?`: forwarded into every item's `context.signal`. When `run()` starts, the transaction mirrors the abort state of the signal you passed; without one, items receive a lazily created signal that never aborts.
`deadlineAt` / `scheduler`: shared by every item in one `run()`, not recomputed per item.
`pending?`: after every item is released, `pending.drain()` is awaited once so that work started by the releases can finish (typically a `createPendingTracker()`).

Descriptor checks (types and accessors of `order`, `custom`, `graceful`, `gracefulTimeoutMs`, `force`) are made per item. One item's invalid descriptor (coded `INVALID_OPTION`) does not stop the others; it counts as that item's failure under the error policy.

`errorPolicy` behaves like `createErrorCollector`. Under `throw`, a single failure keeps its native instance and an unclassified error gets `SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED` attached; a primitive is wrapped with the original on `cause`; an error that already has a valid source and code keeps it. Several failures become an `AggregateError` coded `SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED`.

blocks.text: `mergeCleanupResults(values)` accepts an array of cleanup results (or PromiseLikes of them), waits for each result's `physicalCompletion` chain and returns a frozen `{ cleanupErrors }`. Errors are merged in input order and, within each input, in the order they were observed now or later. A rejected source Promise is kept as its original error, and no other branch is dropped. It does not rely on realm-local `instanceof Promise`, so Promises from other realms and plain thenables both work.

`ICleanupResult<TError>` is the shared boundary between lifecycle, PluginHost and Tray: the current `cleanupErrors` and the later `physicalCompletion` never contain the same error twice. Domain flags such as logical terminal, ok or cleanupComplete stay with each caller. Do not put the full error list into the physical continuation, or errors are counted twice.

For containers whose `dispose()` must start every disposer synchronously but whose cleanup may finish asynchronously. The ledger is the single source of truth for what is pending, the raw errors and when everything has ended. The caller still decides the order, clears its own registry and turns raw errors into its own throw/report/aggregate contract.
State and identity:

items: It starts `open`; `start()` does not change the state.

The first `seal()` moves to `closing` synchronously, freezes every error observed so far and returns the single outcome. Later `seal()` calls return the same object, and `outcome.physicalCompletion` stays the same Promise.

Once sealed with `pending === 0` it becomes `terminal`; otherwise it becomes `terminal` after the last thenable settles. `whenTerminal()` only waits for that; it does not promise a stable Promise identity.
A valid thenable that never settles keeps the ledger `closing`. The ledger adds no timeout, abort, retry or forced terminal state of its own.

blocks.text: Callbacks and thenables:

items: `start()` first checks that `source` is a string and `callback` a function; invalid input throws `INVALID_OPTION` synchronously without calling the callback.

A callback that throws synchronously, or whose result's `.then` getter throws, is recorded in the error snapshot taken at `seal()`. `start()` does not rethrow item failures, so later items can still be started.
A thenable's `.then` is read once and called with the original thenable as receiver; the first settlement wins. Rejections enter the final ledger in the order they are observed.

Each error is a frozen `{ source, error }`; the original `error` object is never replaced. `physicalCompletion` does not reject because of an item failure, so the ledger never takes over the caller's error policy.

blocks.text: Re-entry and closing:

items: Calling `start()` or `seal()` while an item's callback or thenable probe is still running throws `SCOPE_REENTRANT_OWN` synchronously (with the `disposalLedgerReentrant` message); the outer `start()` records it as that item's synchronous failure.
`start()` after `seal()` throws `SCOPE_CLOSED` synchronously (with the `disposalLedgerClosed` message) without calling the new callback.
There is no rollback: once `closing`, the ledger can only wait for admitted thenables to settle.

blocks.text: Error policy: the ledger always collects raw errors. `firstError` is simply the final ledger's first observation; `throw`, `report`, the `AggregateError` message/source/code and containment of reporter failures all belong to the calling adapter and are not pushed into the ledger.

import {
  createGenerationController,
  type IGenerationController,
  type IGenerationControllerOptions,
  type IGenerationRequest,
  type IGenerationToken
} from '@migaia/lifecycle'

function createGenerationController(options?: IGenerationControllerOptions): IGenerationController

type IGenerationControllerOptions = {
  readonly parentSignal?: IAbortSignal
  readonly onSuperseded?: (info: ILifecycleError) => void
  readonly scheduler?: IScheduler // default systemScheduler
  readonly report?: (error: unknown) => void
}

type IGenerationToken = object

type IGenerationRequest = {
  readonly generation: number
  readonly token: IGenerationToken
  readonly signal: IAbortSignal
}

type IGenerationController = {
  readonly generation: number
  readonly disposed: boolean
  begin(options?: { readonly timeoutMs?: number }): IGenerationRequest
  isCurrent(token: IGenerationToken): boolean
  complete(token: IGenerationToken): boolean
  supersede(reason?: unknown): void
  adopt<T>(
    token: IGenerationToken,
    value: T,
    release: (value: T) => void | PromiseLike<void>,
    onReleaseError?: (error: unknown) => void
  ): boolean
  dispose(reason?: unknown): void
}

blocks.text: A generation counter with one `AbortSignal` per generation; starting a new generation makes the previous one stale:
Edge cases:

items: `begin(options?)`: makes the active generation (if any) stale at once by aborting its `signal`, increments `generation` and returns a new `{ generation, token, signal }`. An invalid `options.timeoutMs` (not finite, or negative) throws `INVALID_OPTION`; after that many milliseconds the generation's `signal` aborts. Calling it after `dispose()` throws `GENERATION_DISPOSED`.
`isCurrent(token)`: whether `token` is still the current generation; always `false` after `dispose()`.
`supersede(reason?)`: makes the current generation stale (aborting its `signal`) while the controller stays usable, so a later `begin()` still works. A no-op after `dispose()`.

`complete(token)`: finishes only the matching current generation: returns `true` and makes the token no longer current. It clears the timer, then removes the parent listener, and leaves the signal un-aborted. A stale or disposed token returns `false` without affecting the current generation. A cleanup failure still surfaces as `GENERATION_CANCELLATION_FAILED` with the original `cause`, and the token is stale afterwards; a later `begin()` still works. Real cancellation keeps using `supersede`, the parent signal, a timeout or `dispose`, which keep the signal and its reason.

`adopt(token, value, release, onReleaseError?)`: when `token` is still current, returns `true` and leaves `value` with the caller. Otherwise calls `release(value)` and returns `false`. A throwing or rejecting `release` is only reported through `onReleaseError` and never affects which generation is current (it does not throw and is not fed into an error policy). If `onSuperseded` is set, the stale path first fires one diagnostic carrying the `GENERATION_SUPERSEDED` code; it is not a failure.
`dispose(reason?)`: final. Afterwards `begin()` always throws `GENERATION_DISPOSED` and `isCurrent()` always returns `false`.

When `parentSignal` aborts, the active generation aborts synchronously (its timer is cleared, the parent listener removed and its own controller aborted). Failures during that cleanup are combined into `GENERATION_CANCELLATION_FAILED`.

function createQuiescenceTracker<TKey extends object>(): IQuiescenceTracker<TKey>
function createStringLeaseRegistry(): IQuiescenceTracker<string>

type IQuiescenceTracker<TKey> = {
  retain(key: TKey): IDisposer // IDisposer = () => void
  count(key: TKey): number
  whenZero(key: TKey): Promise<void> // strict, exclusive wait
  whenZeroOnce(key: TKey): Promise<void> // non-exclusive wait
  seal(key: TKey): void
  isSealed(key: TKey): boolean
  forget(key: TKey): boolean
}

blocks.text: Counts leases per key: object keys use a `WeakMap` (collected with the key), string keys use a `Map` (an unsealed entry is removed when its count reaches zero):
Neither factory takes arguments. Edge cases:

items: `retain(key)`: throws `QUIESCENCE_SEALED` on a sealed key. The returned release function is idempotent (it decrements only on the first call).
`whenZero(key)`: you must `seal(key)` first, or it throws `QUIESCENCE_UNSEALED_WAIT` synchronously (not as a rejected Promise). Resolves immediately when the count is already zero.
`whenZeroOnce(key)`: needs no seal; waits for the next time the count reaches zero and does not block new `retain()` calls.
`seal(key)`: idempotent; the key rejects new leases from then on.

`forget(key)`: removes stored state only when its count is zero and nobody is waiting. The return value says whether this call actually deleted state; an absent or automatically pruned entry also returns `false`, which does not imply a positive count.
An unsealed string key that reaches zero is removed from the underlying `Map` automatically, so it does not linger; a sealed key keeps the fact that it is sealed.

blocks.text: The same engine under lease-oriented names (they call `createQuiescenceTracker()` / `createStringLeaseRegistry()` internally), for call sites where "lease" reads better. No arguments.
A narrow interface exposing only `track`, `drain` and `size`, for tracking and draining Promises in flight (built on one string-keyed `createStringLeaseRegistry()`):

blocks.code:
const pending = createPendingTracker()
pending.track(doWork()) // returns the same promise
await pending.drain() // waits until size is 0; work tracked while draining is not missed
pending.size // number of Promises in flight

blocks.text: No arguments. Once a tracked promise settles (resolved or rejected), its lease is released automatically. `drain()` never throws. It loops on `whenZeroOnce()`, so Promises tracked during the drain are waited for as well.
Two-phase ownership during construction: resources wait here until you either `commitTo(parent)` them to their real owner or `rollback()` and release them. You choose one, once:
Edge cases:

items: `own(resource, descriptor)`: throws `PROVISIONAL_SETTLED` after commit or rollback, and `INVALID_OPTION` for an invalid descriptor shape (`order` is not read here; the parent's `own()` checks it at commit).

`commitTo(parent)`: calls `parent.own(resource, descriptor)` for each resource in registration order. If one fails, everything already handed over stays with the parent, and everything not yet handed over is released in reverse order and awaited before the original error is rethrown, so no resource is left owned by nobody. If the cause is that `parent` is already `closing`/`terminal` (code `SCOPE_CLOSED`/`SCOPE_TERMINAL`), the error is wrapped as `PROVISIONAL_PARENT_CLOSED` with the original on `cause` and the release failures of leftover resources on `errors`.

`rollback()`: releases every registered resource in reverse order. A single failure keeps its coded native instance; a primitive is wrapped with the original on `cause`; several failures become an `AggregateError` coded `SCOPE_DISPOSAL_FAILED`. Concurrent and repeated calls share one Promise.

A repeated rollback returns the first Promise, including its rejection. Rolling back after a successful commit, committing twice, or committing after rollback is rejected with `PROVISIONAL_SETTLED` (rollback returns a rejected Promise).
When `parentSignal` aborts (already at construction, or later), `signal` aborts synchronously too, but that does not trigger rollback or commit; the caller must still choose one.

blocks.text: A strict first-in-first-out queue that runs one task at a time, with an optional watchdog for how long a task may wait to start:
Edge cases:

items: `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs`: a number removes a task that has waited longer than that and rejects it with `QUEUE_ADMISSION_TIMEOUT`; `undefined` (the default) only diagnoses and never rejects for waiting; `false` does not even start the diagnostic timer.
`admissionDiagnosticMs`: the diagnostic threshold, used only when `queueAdmissionTimeoutMs` is `undefined` and `onAdmissionDiagnostic` is provided; `false` turns the diagnostic timer off.

`owner`: detects self-dependency. If an owner whose task is running submits a new task to the same queue, that submission is rejected at once with `QUEUE_SELF_DEPENDENCY`, because a FIFO queue cannot run the new task before the current one finishes. This is partial protection: a running task that submits a task with a different or no `owner` and awaits it also deadlocks, but nothing reliably signals that case, so it is not intercepted. The safe pattern is to submit follow-up work without awaiting it inside the current task.
`size`: read-only; tasks waiting plus 0 or 1 running.

blocks.text: Turns any duck-typed value into a standard `IScheduler` snapshot (checked, with accessors read once so a hostile getter cannot be read twice):

blocks.text: One argument `value: unknown`, no options. Returns `undefined` when neither `now` nor `schedule` is a function, and throws `TypeError` (`INVALID_OPTION`) when reading `now` or `schedule` throws. The snapshot's `schedule()` validates the delay, calls the injected `schedule`, then reads the returned task's `cancel` and `unref` once each, in that order. A missing or non-function `cancel` throws `INVALID_OPTION`. A function `unref` gives the snapshot task an `unref()` forwarded with the original task as receiver; without one the snapshot task has no `unref`. If reading `unref` throws (native `TypeError`, original value on `cause`) or it is not a function, `INVALID_OPTION` is thrown after calling the `cancel` already read, so the timer the injected scheduler started is rolled back. If that rollback fails, the primary error is unchanged and the rollback error is attached on its `errors`.

No arguments and no custom factory. The object is built by the current realm's own `globalThis.AbortController`; lifecycle returns no facade, Proxy or home-made EventTarget. items: `abort()` and `abort(undefined)` use the host's default reason, usually a native `DOMException` named `AbortError`, not `undefined`.

An explicit reason other than `undefined` keeps its `===` identity. When an `undefined` reason from a structural parent signal is forwarded to a native child, it is normalised to the host `AbortError` as well.
Repeated `abort()` calls are idempotent and do not overwrite the first reason.

An external listener that throws goes through the host EventTarget's error channel; `try/catch` around `controller.abort()` cannot catch it, and lifecycle does not provide an `ABORT_LISTENER_FAILED` error.

Parent and cancellation callbacks that lifecycle registers itself go through a module-private observed subscription. It handles a signal that is already aborted, an abort during registration, a re-check after registration and idempotent removal, and sends its own callback/read/cleanup failures to the matching operation's collect or report boundary. It does not proxy, enumerate or catch other listeners on the same signal.

blocks.text: `task` and `deadlineAt` are required; `deadlineAt` is an absolute time on the scheduler's clock and is validated. A `.catch()` is always attached to `task`, timeout or not, so a later rejection does not become an unhandled rejection. `abortableDelay(scheduler, ms, signal, reportCleanup?)` is imported from the root `@migaia/lifecycle` entry. `scheduler` does the timing; `ms` must be finite and non-negative; `signal` may be `undefined`. It returns `Promise<boolean>`: `true` when the delay elapses, `false` when the abort event comes first. The caller decides whether cancellation should become a domain `AbortError`. The result of a synchronous callback is not committed until listener registration and scheduler admission have finished; an admission failure stays the primary error and the original error instance or cause chain stays traceable. The task handle is cancelled at most once, and the abort listener is managed by the module's single observed-subscription helper.

By default a cleanup failure rejects the wait; with `reportCleanup(error)`, cleanup failures go to that observer instead and do not replace a completed or cancelled result. Registration or scheduling failures still reject; `DELAY_FAILED` keeps the native Error's identity and stack, or keeps the original value on `cause` when identity cannot be attached. An invalid duration or cleanup reporter is rejected with `INVALID_OPTION` before admission.

`boundedWait(task, deadlineAt, { scheduler, reportCleanup? })` still races an absolute deadline against a task and does not cancel the task. Its default cleanup-failure behaviour is unchanged; the optional `reportCleanup` lets, for example, a logger flush report a timer cleanup failure as a diagnostic while keeping the task-or-deadline winner. Batch debounces, periodic health checks and budget grant timers are not one-shot relative delays and are not forced into this helper.

sections.heading: Method calls and when descriptors and options are read

blocks.text: The objects returned by `createLifecycleScope`, `createSyncLifecycleScope`, `createProvisionalScope` and `createMutationQueue` define their methods on the prototype, so call them on the object (`scope.own(...)`, `queue.enqueue(...)`). Destructuring a method and calling it on its own (`const { own } = scope`) is not supported.

`own()` keeps a snapshot of the descriptor it validates, and release uses that snapshot: changing the descriptor object after registration, or a getter that later returns something else, does not affect release. A provisional scope still hands the original descriptor to `parent.own()` on `commitTo(parent)`, so the parent validates and snapshots it itself.
Options (`errorPolicy`, `report`, `deadlineAt`, `scheduler`, `onAdmissionDiagnostic` and so on) are read once at creation and never again.

`context.signal` in a release callback is created on first read (already aborted, with a `SCOPE_CLOSED` reason). A provisional scope without `parentSignal` also creates its `signal` on first read. Release callbacks that never read the signal cost no AbortController.

sections.heading: Helpers that are no longer public

blocks.text: `createLifecycleUnit` and its option/result types are no longer exported; applications use `createGenerationController` for stale work and keep loading state in their own code. `createStringQuiescenceTracker` was replaced by `createStringLeaseRegistry`, which has real consumers. `validateSchedulerTime`, `validateSchedulerDelay`, `tagLifecycleError` and `createLifecycleRangeError` are internal and exposed neither at the root nor from a leaf. `/scheduler` exposes the snapshot/resolve admission helpers. Error constructors and scheduler arithmetic helpers are internal with no compatibility aliases; application errors use their own module's identity.

The generation controller's `report?: (error: unknown) => void` receives failures nobody else can receive: a stale resource's release error when `adopt()` is called without `onReleaseError`, and timer or parent-listener cleanup errors from an asynchronous timeout. Throws and rejections from the reporter itself go to the shared host error queue from utils; without a reporter these diagnostics are not emitted.

`resolveScheduler`/`snapshotScheduler` preserve an admitted `IScheduler.defer` alongside `now`/`schedule`. Replacing the method later cannot redirect owners that already registered; raw getters are read during admission. Missing required methods still make `snapshotScheduler` return `undefined`, while getter failures preserve their cause and a supplied malformed `defer` throws a coded `TypeError`. This adds no second clock and does not change deadline cancellation. An older object may omit `defer` and rely on the utils deferred helper's zero-delay fallback.

blocks.text: 代数 + 每代一个 `AbortSignal`，新一代自动使旧一代失效：
边界行为：

items: `begin(options?)`：使当前活跃代（若存在）立即失效（触发其 `signal` 中止），`generation` 自增，返回新的 `{ generation, token, signal }`。`options.timeoutMs?` 非法（非有限/负数）抛 `INVALID_OPTION`；超过该毫秒数后当前代的 `signal` 自动中止。控制器已 `dispose()` 后调用抛 `GENERATION_DISPOSED`。
`isCurrent(token)`：`token` 是否仍是当前代；`dispose()` 之后恒为 `false`。
`supersede(reason?)`：作废当前代（其 `signal` 中止）但控制器本身仍可用，之后 `begin()` 仍能开新代；对已 `dispose()` 的控制器调用是空操作。

`complete(token)`：只释放匹配的当前代，返回 true 并使 token 不再 current；先清 timer、再移除 parent listener，保持 signal 未中止。stale/disposed token 返回 false，不影响当前代。cleanup 失败仍以原 `GENERATION_CANCELLATION_FAILED` 保留原 cause，失败后 token 已作废；后续 `begin()` 仍可用。真正取消继续使用 `supersede`/parent/timeout/dispose，保持原 signal 与 reason。

`adopt(token, value, release, onReleaseError?)`：`token` 仍是当前代时返回 `true`，`value` 留给调用方；否则调用 `release(value)` 回收并返回 `false`——`release` 本身抛出/reject 只会经 `onReleaseError` 上报，绝不反过来污染"当前是哪一代"这一状态（不会抛出、不会重新计入错误策略）。若提供了 `onSuperseded`，在过期路径上先额外触发一次携带 `GENERATION_SUPERSEDED` 码的诊断信息（非失败信号）。
`dispose(reason?)`：终态；之后 `begin()` 恒抛 `GENERATION_DISPOSED`，`isCurrent()` 恒 `false`。
`parentSignal` 中止时，当前活跃代同步中止（清理 timer、移除 parent listener、abort 自身 controller）；清理过程中任一步失败会聚合为 `GENERATION_CANCELLATION_FAILED`。

blocks.text: 通用异步所有权容器：
边界行为：

items: `own(resource, descriptor)`：容器处于 `closing`/`terminal` 时抛 `SCOPE_CLOSED`/`SCOPE_TERMINAL`；在 disposer 内部重入调用抛 `SCOPE_REENTRANT_OWN`；descriptor 形状非法（`order`/`custom`/`graceful`/`gracefulTimeoutMs`/`force`，规则同 dispose 时的 descriptor 校验）时在注册时就抛 `INVALID_OPTION`，访问器抛错则原样抛出。
`release(resource)`：反注册但不释放（调用方已自行释放），返回是否找到并移除了该条目；若曾设置 `gcFallback`，同时 unregister 对应的 `FinalizationRegistry` 条目。
`close()`：同步、幂等；`open → closing`。

`dispose()`：逆序（LIFO）释放全部已注册资源；并发多次调用复用同一个 Promise；需要在 disposer 中表达 owner self-join 时使用 `context.disposer.join()`，该操作抛 `SCOPE_REENTRANT_DISPOSE` 且不改变 canonical Promise；容器已 `terminal` 时仍返回首次 dispose Promise，保留原结果或 rejection。`errorPolicy: 'collect'` 时返回值为收集到的 `ICollectedError[]`；其余三种策略要么抛出要么内部上报，返回空数组。
提供 `[Symbol.asyncDispose](): Promise<void>`，可直接用于 `await using`（TypeScript 需包含 `ESNext.Disposable` 类型库）。
